steps.description: Rewrite the README:287-292 blockquote. OLD (exact): the 6-line '> **Recommended model: Opus 4.8, not Opus 5.** ...' blockquote ending '> explicitly with `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` (below).'. NEW: '> **Opus tier resolves naturally.** IronClaude no longer pins its Opus tier to a specific version: every internal Opus-tier string uses the bare `opus` alias, which the Claude CLI resolves to current-latest Opus (as the `sonnet`, `haiku`, and `fable` tiers already do). An earlier pin to `claude-opus-4-8` existed because Opus 5 was too eager to improvise to follow the structured brainstorm -> plan -> execute workflow reliably; Opus 5.5 resolves that, so the pin is retired. To force a specific build, set `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` (below).' Full text in human plan Task 2 Step 1.

Add a new '## [Unreleased]' CHANGELOG entry immediately below the versioning blockquote and above '## 1.1.12' describing the unpin (full text in human plan Task 2 Step 2). Do NOT modify the historical entry that records the original pin.
